name: Atari ST
description: Atari Corporation's 16-bit home computer, launched in 1985 shortly after Jack Tramiel took over Atari. It paired a Motorola 68000 with a GEM desktop at a low price. Built-in MIDI ports made it a long-running fixture in music studios.
curiosities: It was nicknamed the "Jackintosh" after Jack Tramiel and its Mac-like desktop.
Built-in MIDI ports made it a common studio computer, and Steinberg's Cubase first appeared on it.
Its desktop was GEM, licensed from Digital Research.
The 1989 STE update added a blitter, a 4,096-colour palette and stereo DMA sound.
